content.direction: A small warm kid's bedroom with a bunk bed, full of afternoon light and the happy clutter of an eight-year-old who dreams about science and loves picture card play with his brother and sister. Dusty-blue walls show scuffs and worn spots, taped-up kid drawings of planets and beakers with pictures only and no lettering, and tiny glow stars across the ceiling. A sturdy bunk bed with rumpled kid bedding stands along the back wall, with toys tucked underneath and a school backpack and sneakers dropped nearby. Along the left wall a chunky boxy television sits on a low wooden stand, with a generic game console and tangled controllers on the floor, its screen holding a soft blank glow with no figures and no lettering. A low rug in the middle holds binders and rubber-banded stacks of generic trading cards with picture-only backs and a half-played card battle spread, all with no lettering, no numbers and no logos. A small desk and shelf hold a toy microscope, a magnifying glass, plain jars for a kid chemistry set, and a small rock collection. A dresser holds a few spare pairs of kid sunglasses. On a shelf sits a folded geometric-patterned prayer rug with prayer beads. All architecture and dressing are proposed production design inspired by the locked story facts, not a reconstruction of a documented childhood home. Layout: the bunk bed runs along the back wall, the television and low stand run along the left wall, the dresser and shelf run along the right wall, a simple wooden chair sits screen-right angled inward, open rug floor is kept centre and screen-left for the conversation with clean wall kept behind both future face positions, and the camera is at child eye level near the doorway looking toward the back wall for a medium-wide view that can push straight toward a medium two-shot. Light: warm late-afternoon Texas sun through slatted blinds, strong and readable with soft room fill. Bounce: warm bounce off honey wood floor and soft bounce off dusty-blue walls. Practicals: one small bedside lamp, off. Haze: no. Palette: warm honey wood, dusty blue and soft gold at roughly three to one. Accent: saturated tomato-red on generic trading-card backs and toy microscope details.
